objectives.description: command-gate-in.sh: hold ABORT arm inside the non-revise block, ahead of the lock acquire, no forcing-flag override
commands/orchestrate.md STAGE 0: three-category restructure (hold branches on FORCE_PHASES_FLAG), distinct skipped_tasks reporting

approaches_tried.reason: commands/orchestrate.md is markdown with embedded bash, not a sourced script, so the STAGE 0 validated_tasks loop was extracted via awk directly from the source-store file and run in an isolated subshell against a synthetic specs/state.json -- same technique used for the ad hoc /todo subtask-blocking smoke test in Phase 4, now landed as a permanent regression case.

deviations.description: command-gate-in.sh and commands/orchestrate.md were actually implemented earlier in this dispatch (during the orchestrate-triage-classify.sh/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh work), before this phase's own progress file existed, because the hold-dispatch-exclusion work and the single-command-gate work are closely related and were done in one sitting. No functional impact -- the files were left uncommitted until this phase's checklist and tests were complete, and are committed together with this phase.
deviations.reason: Efficiency: avoided re-reading/re-deriving the same orchestrate.md/command-gate-in.sh context twice across two separate phase sessions.
